patterns.note: Prominent use of full-bleed, high-quality editorial photography, often spanning the full width of the viewport, creating a luxurious and immersive feel.
A persistent left-aligned navigation menu appears after the initial hero, providing quick access to product categories.
A sophisticated serif font is used for primary headings and brand messaging, contrasting with clean, legible sans-serif for body text and UI elements.
A muted, natural color palette dominated by off-whites, creams, and deep greys, allowing the product photography to be the focal point.
A dual-sticky navigation system where both a top header and a left-aligned sidebar remain visible after initial scroll, providing continuous access to site navigation.
Product grids are presented with generous spacing between items and clear, minimal product information, emphasizing visual appeal over dense data.

technique_notes: The site employs a dual-sticky navigation system: a top header bar and a left-aligned sidebar navigation. The top bar is always present, while the sidebar appears once the initial hero section is scrolled past, both remaining fixed in the viewport.
Large, full-bleed editorial photography is used to establish mood and showcase products, often serving as section dividers or hero elements.
Product listings utilize a clean grid layout with minimal text, relying on high-quality imagery to convey product appeal.

design_tokens.type_scale: Elegant, medium-sized serif headings (~2-3x body) with smaller, clean sans-serif body text and uppercase labels.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy, particularly in hero and between major content blocks, creating a sense of luxury and breathing room. Product grids maintain a balanced, consistent spacing.

standout: The site's standout feature is its commitment to high-end editorial photography and sophisticated serif typography, which elevates it beyond a typical e-commerce experience into a luxury brand showcase. The persistent left-aligned navigation, appearing after the hero, is also a distinctive and elegant solution for category browsing.
